about.title: About
about.intro_1: This site is a purely private project, emerged from the personal motivation of trying out some future scenarios and seeing how the Austrian power system can become climate neutral by using renewable energies in combination with energy storage.
about.intro_2: Due to the complexity and intermittent nature of particularly wind and solar energy, such scenarios have to be simulated ideally with high time resolutions such as hourly or lower. This way, diurnal patterns (daytime solar) and also seasonal effects can be correctly captured.
about.github_text: The complete code of the site is available at the {link}. Any feedback, constructive criticism, or direct contributions are very welcome and greatly appreciated!
about.tracker_text: Check out also my {link}, where I collect many datasets related to the sustainable transition of Austria and try to project yearly greenhouse gas emissions based on latest energy consumption statistics.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.text: This page is hosted as a GitHub Pages website. GitHub may collect some user information such as IP addresses upon visit of this website. For details see the explanation on {link1} and the there linked general {link2}. Besides data collected directly via GitHub, this page does not track any other data and does not collect any cookies.
